name: Alther's Mill
label: Quest
description: Alther's Mill: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.
Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
